"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Some Guard and Reserve members have been on the ground in Iraq for as many as 15 months, longer than was expected or promised.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many Guard and Reserve units are being pushed to the limit and stretched far too thin.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration's response to the strain on the Guard and Reserves has been to stretch them further.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has extended tours of duty for Guard and Reserve members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has delayed retirements for Guard and Reserve members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has prevented enlisted personnel from leaving the service.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is effectively using a stop-loss policy and recall of Individual Ready Reserve members as a back-door draft.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to add 40,000 new soldiers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 40,000 new soldiers will not increase the number of soldiers in Iraq.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 40,000 new soldiers will sustain overseas deployments and prepare for other possible conflicts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The addition of 40,000 soldiers will help relieve the strain on troops and bring back more soldiers, guardsmen and reservists.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to keeping the military operating on a volunteer basis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to management reform to ensure defense funding is spent effectively.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to management reform to help pay for the new forces.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
